pages.title: Western Camel
pages.text: The western camel ($(o)Camelops hesternus$()) is an extinct camel that lived across western North America during the Pleistocene, until about 13,000 years ago.$(br2)It was somewhat taller than the living dromedary, with longer legs.$(br2)Ancient DNA shows it was more closely related to the camels of the Old World than to llamas. It was a mixed feeder that browsed on shrubs as well as grazing.
